Voluntary context switches are a wakeup proxy, not device-wide wakeups.

Sampling can miss threads which start and exit entirely between reads.
Cold launches retain filesystem and library caches and measure the first activity frame, not full library readiness.
The synthetic tone is the same workload for every app; it does not represent every real music file.
